newsArray.title: 'India always one step ahead' - Deepti Sharma confident ahead of Pakistan clash in Women's Asia Cup
newsArray.description: India are set to take on Pakistan on September 5 in their final group game in the ongoing Women’s Asia Cup 2026. Ahead of the blockbuster clash, all-rounder Deepti Sharma has backed the team’s overall balance. She noted that the side has performed well in both batting and bowling department and is confident of their chances against the arch-rivals.
creator: koustav sengupta
